text:
Ava: Quick thread — finalizing guest pathways and backstage timers for the April 4 webinar. Need to lock demo timeboxes and who hot-swaps if a demo fails.
Miguel: SGTM. what's the total show length? 45 min + 15 Q?
Ava: 60 total. Proposed rundown: 
```
00:00 - 00:02 Intro (host)
00:02 - 00:12 Narrative / benchmarks (presenter)
00:12 - 00:25 Demo A (Speaker 1) — 10 min live + 3 min rapid Q/hand-off
00:25 - 00:30 Sponsor / transition (90s target)
00:30 - 00:43 Demo B (Speaker 2) — 10 min live + 3 min Q
00:43 - 00:50 Panel + live Q
00:50 - 00:60 Close + CTA / post-webinar survey push
```
Priya: Tight on transitions. Can we compress sponsor plug to 90s and make demo slots strict 10m?
Sam: Yes — we need hard-cut mics and an audible "finish slide" timer in green room. I'll set timers.
Ellen: For demo hot-swap: contingency options are (A) pre-recorded video clip queued in OBS, (B) remote demo by Miguel on a secondary endpoint, (C) quick case study slide if both fail.
Miguel: I can run the pre-recorded clip if a live demo dies. Need someone to hit fallback in green room (press play + switch audio). @Sam?
Sam: I can do that. Cue protocol: if presenter stalls >10s, green room drops "hot-swap" message and I take over.
Priya: Cue shorthand: 
- 00:00-00:10 stall -> "hot-swap"
- Sam presses PLAY on OBS scene "DemoFallback_A"
- Miguel mutes/unmutes as needed and announces short context slide
Ava: Also: audience routing for demo watchers — route HubSpot list to Sales SDR queue 3, tag lead as "webinar-demo-A" and include demo-specific follow-up snippet.
Ellen: We'll add a 1-question poll at the end of Demo A asking "Interested in a dedicated trial?" to capture intent.
Miguel: Rehearsal plan: tech check 30m before show, full presenter walk at -20m, run live demo once, then 2 dry-run cutovers. Can we book 9:00–10:15 PT on 4/3 for rehearsal?
Priya: Booked the green room 9:00–10:30 PT on 4/3 and sent invites to speakers + AV.
Ava: Can speakers confirm their demo assets (links, model endpoints, credentials) in this thread by EOD Friday?
Sam: I'll paste the green room timer script tomorrow.
Ellen: I'll draft the survey + follow-up copy and post here.
Miguel: I'll upload fallback video and a short obs checklist (link) once encoded.
Ava: Perfect — final ask: keep demo code snippets minimal on slide (single command or curl) and have a static screenshot ready in case of rendering issues. :thumbsup:
